title: nonlinear top-2 Mirror expert views
hypothesis: For a learned top-2 MoE teacher whose nonlinear expert functions are related by per-role Givens coordinates, one shared FFN with charged role-specific views recovers probability-weighted routed output at lower serialized bytes than untied MoE and beats hard tying plus byte-near FiLM/rank-2 residual controls; unrelated experts require private weights.
scope_delta: Unlike MA-003/MA-001 top-1, two router-selected nonlinear expert outputs are composed with normalized selected probabilities per token. Unlike MA-005 all-expert deterministic signed mixture, this uses learned input-conditioned sparse top-2 routing.
mirror_coordinate: four learned four-angle Givens views on 16D input and output, one per logical expert role
logical_multiplicity: four router-addressable nonlinear experts, two weighted active roles per input
controls: untied standard top-2 MoE with dense router
untied top-2 MoE with rank-2 factorized router
ordinary hard-tied expert with dense router
tied expert plus per-role hidden FiLM
tied expert plus per-role rank-2 output residual
tied expert plus per-role Mirror Givens views

teacher.router: frozen linear teacher scores from a seeded 16x4 matrix; target is full teacher softmax distillation and routed set is top-2; mixture weights are teacher/student softmax probabilities renormalized over selected roles
teacher.aligned: one frozen nonlinear FFN conjugated by per-role Givens input/output views
teacher.independent: four independently initialized frozen nonlinear FFNs
teacher.samples: standard normal 16D; independent train/validation/test tensors from world-seeded generators

task.structure_audit: top-2 set agreement, router KL, and per-role selected count

development.selection_metric: arithmetic mean held-out mixture MSE across six methods and both teacher modes

fresh.access_condition: At selected LR, aligned Mirror MSE <=1.25x dense untied top-2 MSE and Mirror actual payload <=0.65x dense untied payload. If either fails, fresh remains sealed.

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: torch.save complete CPU state dict plus deterministic compact JSON config

gates.development_open_fresh: At selected LR, aligned Mirror MSE <=1.25x dense untied top-2 and actual payload <=0.65x dense untied; otherwise FAIL and fresh sealed.
gates.fresh_useful_sharing_pass: In all three aligned fresh worlds: Mirror MSE <=1.10x dense untied top-2, top-2 set accuracy no more than 1 percentage point below dense, payload <=0.65x dense.
gates.mirror_specific: In all aligned fresh worlds: Mirror MSE at least 10% lower than hard tying, FiLM, and rank-2 residual; payload no larger than each; active MAC plus coordinate proxy <=1.10x each.
gates.fail: Development access gate misses, or after access useful sharing fails in at least two worlds, or a simpler control matches Mirror MSE within 10% at equal/lower bytes and <=1.10x compute in at least two worlds.
gates.promising: Fresh useful-sharing gate passes at least 2/3 worlds, or passes 3/3 while mirror-specific Pareto gate misses due an identified simpler-control/storage/runtime tradeoff.
gates.not_established: Invalid split, missing worlds, non-deterministic serialization, or unreproducible training.

boundaries: aligned teacher deliberately favors Givens views
fixed 1,200-update screen is not capacity or near-convergence evidence
independent teacher probes but does not define full private-parameter boundary
no natural-language, optimized GPU or load-balance claim
